title: Cup of Endless Water
summary: An unobtainable cup that casts Incongruent Splash once per battle.

fields.Incongruent Splash: Action once per battle. A roughly 16 ft cone deals 3d6 Fire with a Dexterity save against caster DC for half. Applies Wet for 3 turns after damage, even on a successful save.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
